narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Three, four and five tenths make twelve tenths, so I write two tenths. The bee is fourteen and two tenths.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>But twelve tenths is ten tenths and two more, and ten tenths is a whole unit.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Dropping that unit would make the bee one whole unit too short.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Add all the units, and then add all the tenths together. Then turn every ten tenths into one unit.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Your turn. Add one and four tenths, two and three tenths and three and six tenths.
